description: Amends St. John's Cathedral heritage bylaw for property subdivision.
Allows cathedral to sell surplus land for cultural project.
Protects cathedral viewsheds and sunlight in new development.

chips.text: Riversdale BID supported, citing architect Mr. Seaman's reputation.
Similar amendments were approved by City Council in 2008.
Administration has not yet reviewed the final project build-out design.
Cathedral Property Committee Chair Bert Munro responded to questions.
Administration will update MHAC as the project progresses.

description: Saskatoon committee members identified heritage conservation best practices.
Key takeaways included accessibility, community-led projects, and plaque programs.
Members proposed aligning heritage policies to national standards.

chips.text: Political will, not money, is the main barrier to heritage conservation.
Property owners could receive incentives for maintaining heritage assets.
An attendee from PEI criticized Saskatoon's heritage conservation efforts.

description: Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee submits 2024 annual report by March 31, 2026.
Subcommittees reported on various referred matters.
